management_notes: CEO transition in May 2026 (Tasheel Jeerh replacing interim CEO Conan McIntyre) introduces execution uncertainty at a critical pre-resource juncture. McIntyre remains on the board. Insider buying provides partial offset: Director Malik Easah exercised 10M warrants at $0.15 (approximately $1.5M commitment) in November 2025, and McIntyre purchased 2M shares at $0.05 in July 2025. New CEO Jeerh has no visible track record at CRI yet, and leadership continuity risk is elevated during a drill-program phase when operational momentum matters.
geology_notes: Frost Cove Antimony Mine prospect on the Black Raven Property, Newfoundland and Labrador. Final 2025 drill holes returned high-grade antimony: 7.25% Sb over 1.98m, 6.44% Sb over 2.06m, 4.84% Sb over 1.00m, and 3.94% Sb over 1.60m along an 800m strike with 100m vertical depth — open in all directions. A second polymetallic system has also been discovered on the property. A two-rig 2026 drill program is underway with nine holes completed and assays pending from the northern Frost Cove extension. No NI 43-101 resource estimate exists yet; Churchill is gathering drill data to support a maiden resource. Grade is genuinely high for a primary antimony system, but intersection widths are narrow (classic vein-hosted morphology) and no resource envelope has been defined. Score is mid-range pending resource delineation.
capital_notes: 316.7M shares outstanding as at the April 2026 MD&A is a heavy load for a pre-resource stage explorer. Fully diluted sits at 342.8M — only approximately 8% dilution from instruments, which is manageable. Outstanding instruments per April 2026 MD&A: 2.625M warrants (strike/expiry not extracted from MD&A summary table) and 23.45M options (strike/expiry not extracted). No flow-through tranches were detected in the April 2026 MD&A or available public disclosures. Recent financings: $3M non-brokered PP at $0.08/share (September 2025, 37.5M shares); 25M warrants exercised at $0.15 for $3.75M treasury addition (November 2025). Cash position should be reasonable near-term from the November warrant exercise, but continued drilling and a maiden resource estimate will likely require another raise at the current exploration pace.
catalyst_notes: Near-term: assay results from nine 2026 drill holes are pending — these are the highest-impact catalyst in the immediate window. Medium-term: maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate is the company's stated objective and would be a significant de-risking event. Golden Baie antimony-gold option agreement received TSXV approval, adding an incremental news flow. Macro backdrop is strongly positive: China's antimony export restrictions (effective September 2024) have created a sustained supply squeeze and elevated prices, directly benefiting Western primary antimony projects. New CEO appointment may attract fresh investor attention. Risk: pending drill results could disappoint given the narrow, irregular vein-hosted system seen to date.
acquisition_notes: No resource estimate makes P/NAV calculation impossible at this stage; nav_per_share is not calculable. Historical Frost Cove Antimony Mine infrastructure suggests economic precedent on the property. Antimony's critical mineral designation (driven by defence and battery applications) makes any advanced Western project strategically valuable to acquirers, and comparable transactions for primary antimony assets are extremely scarce globally. However, pre-resource stage and narrow drill widths mean a strategic buyer has limited data to underwrite. Acquisition optionality is real but speculative until a resource is defined.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources holds one of the few active primary Western antimony projects (Frost Cove, Newfoundland) at a moment when China's export restrictions have fundamentally re-rated the commodity's strategic value. High-grade 2025 intercepts — up to 7.25% Sb over 1.98m along an 800m open-ended strike — validate the mineralised system, and nine 2026 drill holes are awaiting assays. The macro case for Western antimony is compelling. However, no resource estimate exists, the share count (316.7M outstanding) is large for a pre-resource explorer, and a CEO transition in May 2026 adds near-term execution uncertainty. WATCH: pending assay results are the next decision point; a maiden resource announcement would materially upgrade the investable case.
